contract.purpose: Define the evidence required to resolve all known D1 data blockers before corpus expansion or serious-pretraining authorization.

corpusScaleTarget.existingAuthorityFinding: research/d1/d1_data_acquisition_contract.json states that the final model-training token budget is not yet locked and must use corpus quality, tokenizer statistics, compute throughput and measured MPS training cost.

nonApplicableExistingValues.reason: These are tokenizer corpus planning values, not serious D1 model-pretraining targets.

corpusScaleTarget.requiredNextDecision: A separately authorized, evidence-based scale-planning decision must establish and hash a serious-pretraining corpus target before acquisition or expansion.

blockers.name: CORPUS SCALE
blockers.purpose: Establish an evidence-based corpus scale sufficient for the intended serious-pretraining objective.
requiredEvidence: documented rationale relating corpus scale to the locked 26,655,104-parameter model
blockers.completionCondition: A separately authorized, versioned and SHA-256-hashed planning artifact defines a measurable minimum accepted-token target and the sealed corpus manifest demonstrates that target without duplication-based padding.
prohibitedShortcuts: adopting the tokenizer-development byte targets as model-pretraining targets
inventing a token target without evidence
counting duplicated or rejected content toward the target
authorizing training from relative D0 scale alone
blockers.hashingVersioningRequirements: All planning inputs, tokenizer identity and corpus/token-count artifacts must be versioned and SHA-256 bound.
blockers.passSemantics: PASS only when the locked target exists and the final accepted corpus meets it after all quality exclusions.
blockers.failClosedSemantics: FAIL_CLOSED if no target authority exists, inputs mismatch, usable tokens are below target, or scale is inflated by prohibited content.

blockers.name: COMPOSITE CORPUS DEDUPLICATION
blockers.purpose: Measure and resolve exact and policy-governed near duplication across the complete composite corpus.
blockers.completionCondition: Every retained document participates in a reproducible whole-corpus duplicate analysis; exact duplicates are resolved under a frozen rule and near-duplicate handling is measured and adjudicated.
blockers.hashingVersioningRequirements: Dedup implementation/configuration, input manifest, findings and output manifest require version and SHA-256 identity.
blockers.passSemantics: PASS only after reproducible aggregate exact-dedup completion and explicit near-duplicate adjudication.
blockers.failClosedSemantics: FAIL_CLOSED on incomplete coverage, identity mismatch, missing retention decisions or unverifiable output.

blockers.name: CONTAMINATION ANALYSIS
blockers.purpose: Demonstrate that training/development material does not contain protected formal evaluation content or prohibited benchmark-answer injections.
blockers.completionCondition: A frozen protocol completes across the sealed corpus and records pass/fail findings without exposing protected examples or using formal results to shape training data.
prohibitedShortcuts: opening protected examples during corpus construction
using formal scores for corpus selection
substituting synthetic rehearsal for measured findings
blockers.hashingVersioningRequirements: Protocol, corpus, protected-set authority, evaluator and results must be independently versioned and SHA-256 bound.
blockers.passSemantics: PASS only when an authorized contamination analysis completes and every finding is resolved under the frozen policy.
blockers.failClosedSemantics: FAIL_CLOSED on protected-data exposure, incomplete coverage, unresolved matches, identity mismatch or missing measured evidence.

blockers.name: AGGREGATE LANGUAGE/DOMAIN MEASUREMENT
blockers.purpose: Measure the language and domain/category composition of the complete accepted corpus.
blockers.completionCondition: All accepted documents are classified or explicitly marked unknown using a frozen method and aggregate distributions reconcile exactly with the corpus manifest.
prohibitedShortcuts: inferring aggregate composition from source names
claiming multilingual capability from tokenizer coverage
reporting percentages that do not reconcile
blockers.hashingVersioningRequirements: Classifier/method identity, input corpus, document labels and aggregate report require version and SHA-256 identity.
blockers.passSemantics: PASS only when complete measured aggregate language/domain composition reconciles with the sealed corpus.
blockers.failClosedSemantics: FAIL_CLOSED on incomplete coverage, unreported unknowns, non-reconciling totals or identity mismatch.

blockers.name: TRAIN/DEVELOPMENT SPLIT
blockers.purpose: Create a deterministic, leakage-controlled separation between training and development evaluation material.
blockers.completionCondition: Every accepted document is assigned exactly once using a frozen deterministic policy; train/development identities are independently hashed and zero overlap is verified.
prohibitedShortcuts: using protected formal data as development data
changing the split after observing model results
blockers.hashingVersioningRequirements: Policy, assignments, partition manifests and overlap results require version and SHA-256 identity.
blockers.passSemantics: PASS only with deterministic complete assignment, independent manifests and zero prohibited overlap.
blockers.failClosedSemantics: FAIL_CLOSED on unassigned/multiply assigned documents, leakage, post-result mutation or identity mismatch.

blockers.name: FULL TOKENIZER/CORPUS COMPATIBILITY
blockers.purpose: Verify the accepted tokenizer against every accepted corpus partition without retraining or mutation.
blockers.completionCondition: The unchanged accepted tokenizer processes every retained document under a frozen procedure; failures/unknown behavior are adjudicated and aggregate accepted-token counts reconcile with all partitions.
blockers.hashingVersioningRequirements: Tokenizer, corpus partitions, procedure and results require version and SHA-256 binding.
blockers.passSemantics: PASS only when full accepted-corpus coverage succeeds and all counts reconcile under the immutable tokenizer.
blockers.failClosedSemantics: FAIL_CLOSED on incomplete coverage, tokenizer mutation, unsupported-content concealment, count mismatch or identity mismatch.

blockers.name: MALFORMED/EMPTY DOCUMENT VALIDATION
blockers.purpose: Validate every candidate document for decoding, structural integrity, emptiness and unusable content before acceptance.
blockers.completionCondition: Every document in the composite corpus is validated; all malformed, undecodable, empty or unusable documents are explicitly counted and adjudicated, and retained totals reconcile with the sealed manifest.
blockers.hashingVersioningRequirements: Validator/configuration, source inventory, findings, exclusion ledger and output manifest require version and SHA-256 identity.
blockers.passSemantics: PASS only when validation covers every document and all totals and exclusions reconcile reproducibly.
blockers.failClosedSemantics: FAIL_CLOSED on incomplete inventory, unrecorded failures, unresolved malformed content or identity mismatch.
